newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HIH eyes more U.S. expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HIH eyes more U.S. expansion.

text.p: Swiss controlled insurer HIH Winterthur Ltd said on Monday it planned further expansion in the Americas following the buy-back of its former workers compensation unit in the United States.
"There is opportunity to expand into other parts of the U.S. with our Californian licence," John Clarke, general manager public affairs at HIH Winterhur told Reuters.

Earlier, HIH Winterhur said it had bought back Care America Compensation and Liability Insurance Co, a unit of Care America for US$59 million. HIH set up the U.S. group, formerly known as Health Cal in 1987 and then sold it in 1994 for US$93 million.
Clarke said HIH had set up an insurance operation in Argentina last year and planned further expansion in the Americas through the U.S. unit.
He said the group expected net written premium in 1997 expected to be in the region of A$140 million for the Californian workers compensation unit.
"Net premium is expected to be about A$140 million and the operation is likely to be profitable," Clarke said.
HIH is 48 percent-owned by Winterthur Swiss.
HIH shares ended at a record high, up seven cents on the day at A$3.30.
